class.name: mit_system_interface/MitMujocoSystemInterface
class.description: mujoco_ros2_control/MujocoSystemInterface whose joints with a kp command interface take the RobStride MIT-mode commands (position, velocity, kp, kd, t_ff) of the real arm, as in rebot_robstride_protocol: effort = kp (position - q) + kd (velocity - qd) + t_ff.
